tagline: Providing safe, reliable, and sustainable energy to customers and communities
hero_kpi_rationale: MGEE is a utility company. The Transmission Investments segment is a structural driver linked to electric grid modernization, essential for energy transition and reliability.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company after all expenses.
kpis.description: Net income increased due to a higher rate base and favorable weather conditions.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by rate increases and investments.

kpis.name: Electric Utility Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from electricity generation and distribution.
kpis.description: Growth driven by rate base increases and increased residential demand.
kpis.signal: Primary segment experiencing strong growth due to investments and residential demand.

kpis.name: Gas Utility Revenue
kpis.description: Gas sales increased 14%, supported by an 18% increase in heating degree days.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by colder winter conditions.

kpis.name: Nonregulated Energy
kpis.explanation: Revenues outside the regulatory framework, such as special projects or competitive markets.
kpis.description: Revenue stability in this segment with no major developments.
kpis.signal: Modest growth despite a stable environment.

kpis.name: Transmission Investments
kpis.explanation: Revenues related to investments in electricity transmission infrastructure.
kpis.description: Growing contribution to earnings, reflecting network investments.
kpis.signal: Steady growth in a strategic segment for grid modernization.

kpis.name: Solar Capex Investments
kpis.description: Costs incurred through end 2025 for solar projects, representing a significant portion of investments.

kpis.name: Battery Storage Capex Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in battery storage projects.
kpis.description: Significant investments in storage, critical for renewable energy integration.
kpis.signal: Priority given to storage for energy transition.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $3.16B in the latest year

kpis.name: Gas Retail Sales
kpis.explanation: Volume of gas sold to residential and commercial customers.
kpis.description: Gas sales increased 14% in 2025 compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase due to colder winters.

kpis.name: Heating Degree Days
kpis.explanation: Measure of heating demand based on temperature.
kpis.description: Heating degree days increased 18%, partially explaining the rise in gas sales.
